question: Appraise the single study PAIR-26 from its abstract for the AI Engineer evidence registry: its design and population, then what it reported for each appraisal domain (selection, performance, detection, attrition, reporting). Do not rate a body of evidence.

obligations.description: State PAIR-26's design, population, intervention and comparator as the study reports them.
Report what PAIR-26 reported about allocation and selection.
Report what PAIR-26 reported about blinding of participants and personnel.
Report what PAIR-26 reported about blinding of outcome assessment.
Report what PAIR-26 reported about attrition.
Report what PAIR-26 reported about outcome reporting and registration.

qualifierGuidance.entity: Write the study name exactly as PAIR-26 on every assertion.
qualifierGuidance.population: Write the population exactly as: professional software developers.
qualifierGuidance.appraisal: Each domain assertion names its appraisalDomain and an appraisalJudgment (low, some_concerns, high, not_reported); the design assertion has neither.
